reviews.text: Very pleasant person, quick appointment and takes good care of our animals.

My Shetland Sheepdog has been groomed at Amour Canin several times and I'm always very satisfied: meticulous work, a great rapport with my dog, and reasonable prices. I highly recommend this salon for your pets. Thanks to their vigilance, last year they alerted me to a swelling on Ulysses' paw, which allowed for prompt veterinary care (a foxtail had migrated to his knee). Thank you for your professionalism!
Ulysses still looks handsome today 😊

I want to give a very warm thank you to Amour Canin de la Rouviere... the young woman who groomed my Spitz, Willys, is a gem... he looks magnificent... my baby was so happy he was jumping for joy... he felt so handsome 😁 See you soon and lots of licks from Willys, 16 months old 💛💛 …
I have complete confidence in Joana (especially) with my dogs!

During the nail trimming, my dog ​​was injured and bled, which is very worrying for me. I understand that accidents can happen, but there was no remorse or apology.

Furthermore, the amount due was €49. I gave her a €50 note, and she took the liberty of keeping the change without me offering it. I find her completely unprofessional.
A very good grooming professional, she handles even timid dogs very well. I highly recommend her 🙏👍💪👑 …
Today, Titus, a 3-year-old English Cocker Spaniel, really needed a trim. It turned out beautifully. Thank you so much.

Thank you to Joanna for taking such good care of Sydney, the beautiful Saint Bernard.
Joanna has a heart of gold and an unconditional love for our furry friends. 🥰❤️ …
Thank you to Joanna, very professional and especially attentive to the client... I left satisfied with the result for my German Spitz. See you soon.
Trusted groomers. I leave my dog ​​with them without any problem (even if he doesn't want to 🤣). He always comes back looking perfect. They're brave because he sheds like crazy. (Akita Inu) …

I've been taking my dog ​​Pepito to this groomer since July 2024 and I'm always delighted! They are lovely, very professional, and take excellent care of the animals. Pepito adores them and always leaves looking his best. I highly recommend them!

My first experience with Joanna, having just arrived in La Rouviere. She's a pleasant, smiling, and very professional person. Despite a delay caused by my own fault, she managed to handle it in 30 minutes flat, delivering a perfect result. My next appointment is in two and a half months, and I'll definitely be a loyal customer!

An exceptional experience at Amour Canin Marseille!

I recently discovered Amour Canin Marseille, and I am absolutely delighted with the service. The team is passionate, caring, and very professional. My dog ​​was welcomed with gentleness and patience, and I immediately felt he was in good hands.

I'm a regular at this salon: Joana is very professional and very kind. She loves her work and the results always live up to expectations!
I recommend it 100% and I can't imagine going anywhere else for my dog!

Hello,
A quick message to thank you again for your warm welcome and the excellent care you gave my dog, as well as the lovely Christmas bandana you gave him.

You're the best! 👌
For those reading my review, I highly recommend these professionals as they are very serious, attentive, and professional.
Wishing you happy holidays and a Merry Christmas.

Thrilled with this first adventure with my little one 😊 and a little bonus gift: a Christmas bandana 🥰
Definitely something to do again …

It was a first for my big girl, after six years without grooming, so she had her work cut out for her! I was thrilled with the result.
The staff are very friendly and attentive to the dog's well-being, and my dog …
Thank you for your feedback, we're delighted you're satisfied! See you soon!
They take excellent care of my Biewer Pia. Every time, it comes out looking amazing.
